name: onPage / onPageChange / isOnPage
summary: Subscribe to matching routes or all resolved location changes.

npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

signatures.onPage: (pathname: string, sub: PageListener, exact?: boolean, matchGroup?: string) => () => void

types.PageListener: export type PageListener = (active: boolean, location: PageLocation) => void;
types.PathChangeListener: export type PathChangeListener = (pathname: string, query: Record<string, string>, data: Record<string, unknown>) => void;

guidance: Keep the unsubscribe function and call it on teardown. Use onPage when only one route matters.
Window router:change has detail { pathname, query, data }.
